notes.title: Patch 1.0.4
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.4 brings a couple of quality of life improvements:


You can now skip the intro cutscene 
Migrated to Godot version 4.4


Let us know what you are looking for next!

Enjoy Voidstepper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 fixes a couple of bugs:


When starting up the game for the first time, a cat will be saved immediately
Fixed a bug where the cats you already saved would disappear under certain circumstances.


Let us know if you find any other bugs!

Enjoy Voidstepper

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
We've applied a patch that fixes some bugs:


Removed void bombs in levels where they were not supposed to be accessed
Removed the ability to reset the level at the end of sets, causing the timer to reset to an invalid value
Added a cat name to honor the first player to finish the game


If you find any other bugs, please let us know below.

Enjoy Voidstepper!
